summary.text: Yes, for an approved dependant who lacks enough MediSave. Sign the MCAF at their Medical Institution.

details.heading: Who counts as a dependant
details.body: Approved dependants are your spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. They can be of any nationality. Grandparents and siblings must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

details.heading: Withdrawal limits apply
details.body: The amount your family member can use is subject to the MediSave withdrawal limit for that patient, regardless of the number of payers. Any remaining amount must be paid in cash.

details.heading: How payment is made
details.body: The hospital submits the claim. Payment from your MediSave is made directly to the Medical Institution.

steps.name: Go to the Medical Institution
steps.text: Approach the Medical Institution where your family member is receiving treatment.

steps.name: Sign the MCAF
steps.text: Sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form, also called the MCAF.

sources.page_title: Can I use my MediSave to pay for my family member’s outpatient treatment expenses?

quotes.text: If your approved dependants do not have sufficient MediSave for their outpatient treatment expenses, you may consider using your MediSave to pay for them.

Should you wish to use your MediSave for your approved dependants’ medical expenses, you may approach the Medical Institution (MI) where they are receiving treatment at to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF).

Approved dependants refer to a member’s spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings. They can be of any nationality except for grandparents and siblings who must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

While they can tap on your MediSave, the amount they can use is subject to the MediSave withdrawal limits, which is applied on a per patient basis regardless of the number of payers. If they still have outstanding medical expenses after utilising up to the MediSave withdrawal limit, they would have to pay the remainder in cash.
The hospital will then submit the claim to us and payment from your MediSave will be made directly to the MI.
